exact_prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Enhance ONLY this existing complete painted-game UI texture, preserving its whole rectangular UV canvas, original normalized positions, scale, orientation, exact counts, palette, local light/dark hierarchy and contour. Image1 is the exact historical full original RGBA. Image2 is only the same entire storedRGB enlarged with nearest-neighbor, not extra detail. Authoritative full original alpha will be restored separately. Keep the source soft hand-painted game material, with gentle finer painted tonal detail at the original scale. No photographic redesign, relighting, added object, frame, hardware, new scratches, relief, embossing, glossy highlight, grain/noise pattern, text, symbols or sharp outline. Source codec sample cells are shading, not new parts. Do not crop, pad, rotate, repack or change canvas or UV. No comparison/labels. Original255x130, intended1020x520. Exactly ONE wide dark charcoal/brown rectangular slot panel with rounded clipped corners and ONE existing narrow muted brown rim. All four rim sides remain at their original phase, faint warmer top, dim lower/side edges; no inner second border. Preserve nearly black upper interior fading gently to slightly cooler gray lower interior, existing soft mottled painted tone and low contrast. No rivets, fasteners, stitch, leather grain, polished bevel, extra frame, center emblem or light patch. Existing subtle rim retains source width relative to canvas; keep all existing black outer corner spaces.

reference_recipe.operations: Whole canvas nearest integer enlargement only; no crop/padding/registration/unpremultiply. Whole generated output Lanczos exact4x; full originalA restored and pure global scalar brightness in native encoding.
